contentHtml:
It is important to know how to check visa status in UAE. It helps with knowing if the application has been submitted. Or if the date for renewing it is drawing near. In this article, we discuss the exact steps telling you how to check visa status in UAE. We also share how to renew it after you have done visa check status online in UAE.

Documents required to check visa status in UAE

If it is the visa application you are seeking to track by doing a visa status check in Dubai, you are going to need certain documents. General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs is where you will track the visa application after having done a visa status check in Dubai.

Visa that have been applied to Abu Dhabi, Fujairah, Ras Al Khaimah, Sharjah, Ajman, and Umm Al Quwain require you doing a visa check online in UAE. Do it through Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security’s website. The documents required for a visa check status online in UAE would be the application number and reference number. Simply provider the reference number and your application number to the visa service provider assisting you for visa check status online in UAE.

Maybe you already have the entry permit. You are searching how to check visa status in UAE for finding out its validity. For residence visa or entry permit to Abu Dhabi, Ajman, Fujairah, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain, head to the website of ICP for visa status check in UAE. Visa check status online in Dubai when you have the entry permit calls for reaching out to GDRFA.

Valid Passport Details

The process of how to check visa status in UAE can be quite simple at times. All you need is your passport number at hand to get started. With your passport number, you can apply how to check visa status through ICA’s smart service portal.

Visa Application Number

With your visa application number, you can do a visa status check in Dubai too. This will provide you what the exact status of your visa currently is. A visa check status online in Dubai can involve receiving an email. That email will contain the application and reference number to track the status.

Emirates ID Number

In the process of how to check visa status in UAE, Emirates ID number is quite important. It assists you with finding the answer to your visa status check in Dubai.

How to Renew a UAE Visa Before Expiry

One of the reasons for performing a visa check status online in UAE is finding out its expiry. And this is why it becomes possible to renew you visa before expiry.

There are different reasons for learning how to check visa status in UAE. It is necessary for renewing it. You renew your visa for extending your stay or continuing to live legally in the country.

Knowing how to check visa status in UAE becomes very useful in this regard. For renewing your visa, visit GDRFA’s website. If you do not have an account already, create one. Log into your account. Select the option of Renew Residence. Fill the application form. Upload the documents that have been required. Pay the fee for visa renewal. Now it is time to wait for the process to start. Wait for the application to process. Complete the visa check status online in Dubai through GDRFA account. After approval of the application, you are going to need your passport and digital visa.

The process of renewal after a visa status check in Dubai might involve different circumstances for different individuals. It is best to check with your employer or GDRFA.

The wait for your application approval usually consists of forty eight hours. During this time, ICP verifies the data you have entered. They check if it is accurate. Then they proceed with approving your application for renewal. You can use the knowledge of how to check visa status through ICP’s platform. Your passport will have a Residency Permit sticker labelled in it when your application gets approved.

Submission of Documents and Payment

After filling the application form, submit the required documents. Make the payment for renewing visa. Your passport should be valid. Specific types of visa require different kinds of documents. Your visa service provider, like Royal Visa, can best guide you in this regard. Make sure the documents you are submitting are authentic. Discrepancies in document verification can lead to your request getting cancelled. For verifying your documents, you need to get them attested and notarized. Attestation and notarization indicate the authenticity of your documents.

After you have filled your application form and submitted the documents, it is time to pay the fee. The next step with how to check visa status in UAE is to pay required fee through e-Channel platforms. The cost for renewing after visa check status online in Dubai involves visa fee, service provider fee, online service fee and any other related fee. Confirmation of your payment will result in an e-receipt being generated. This acts as a proof of your payment and lets you keep proper track of your payment trail.

Biometric Fingerprints and Medical Test

Verify your fingerprints through biometric. Go through the compulsory medical tests for renewing the document after your visa status check UAE. A medical examination is necessary to ensure your health insurance remains intact.

What to Do If Your Visa Status is Delayed or Rejected

There are times when your visa status might show results to be rejected. Or even delayed. This is when you should take some necessary steps. Make sure the information you entered was not incorrect. Double check the documents that you had submitted. Go through the results of your medical examination. If the reason for your visa status check in Dubai is beyond your control, then contact the relevant authorities handling the process. Your visa service provider can offer you some better insights too.
